name: recibos-verdes-deep-dive-chat
description: Chat-web only. IT career deep-dive on Recibos Verdes regime simplificado in Portugal. Cash-flow timeline and compliance. Not tax or legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat about freelancing, rates, or Recibos Verdes.

inputs.name: tax-year
inputs.description: Fiscal year for rates; default current calendar year Europe/Lisbon.

inputs.name: tax-region
inputs.description: Fiscal residence; affects annual IRS, not RV retenção tables.

inputs.name: gross-billing-monthly
inputs.description: Average monthly gross invoicing in euros.

inputs.name: daily-rate
inputs.description: Daily rate when monthly billing not given.

inputs.name: billable-days-per-year
inputs.description: Billable days per year; default 220 when omitted.

inputs.name: client-concentration-pct
inputs.description: Percent of revenue from largest client (entidade contratante risk).

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: pt-it-recibos-verdes-report
outputs.description: Recibos Verdes deep-dive report; empty until minimum inputs exist.
